name: session-deck
description: A live deck for your Claude Code session: model, context, usage limits, git branch and worktree, open PRs and todos, in a band above the prompt and a side pane.

position.title: Where to show the deck
position.description: band: colored rows above the prompt. status: one plain line under the prompt (the status line takes no colors or line breaks). both: the band plus that line.

showDirectory.title: Show directory
showDirectory.description: Show the working directory next to the branch, trimmed from the left when long.

showPrs.title: Show pull requests
showPrs.description: List open pull requests of the repository (needs the GitHub CLI, gh, signed in).

warnPercent.title: Context warning at (%)
warnPercent.description: Show a toast once when the context window passes this percent.

compactHintPercent.title: Compact hint at (%)
compactHintPercent.description: Show a hint to /compact or start a new session once the context passes this percent.

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache lifetime
cacheTtl.description: How long the prompt cache lives after a request: 5m or 1h. A model switch (/model) lets the engine report the real value, which then wins over this.

notifyAfterSeconds.title: Notify when a message takes longer than (seconds)
notifyAfterSeconds.description: Send a notification and toast when a message finishes after at least this many seconds. 0 turns it off.
